title: Without Delete, the actions menu offers no Deactivate parts or Activate parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-MENU) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-MENU-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in both windows at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the Admin window click the ⋮ actions menu.
  2. Press Esc.
  3. In the Admin window click the Inactive tab and then the ⋮ actions menu.
  4. Press Esc.
  5. In {User-B}'s window click the ⋮ actions menu.
  6. Click Cycle count.
  7. Click Cancel in the toolbar.
  8. In {User-B}'s window click the Inactive tab and then the ⋮ actions menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The Admin's menu shows Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export, in that order, which shows the entry exists on this build.
  • Step 3: The Admin's menu on the Inactive tab shows Cycle count, Activate parts and Export.
  • Step 5: {User-B}'s menu shows Cycle count and Export only; there is no Deactivate parts entry.
  • Step 6: Cycle count starts for {User-B} (its count controls appear), so Cycle count needs nothing more than Create & Edit.
  • Step 7: Cycle count ends and the toolbar is back to normal.
  • Step 8: {User-B}'s menu on the Inactive tab shows Cycle count and Export only; there is no Activate parts entry.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R3, S8-R4, S8-R5, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu) and bulk-note-1, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R3: “A user without that permission does not see the "Deactivate parts" entry in the Inventory actions menu.”
  • S8-R4: “That user does not see the "Activate parts" entry on the Inactive tab.”
  • S8-R5: “The actions menu needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission. Its Cycle count and Export entries need nothing more. Only the bulk status entry also needs the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
